+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robowits import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+ARM = "left"
+
+
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    s = Session("stack_cubes", instance=INSTANCE)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    target = np.asarray(s.objects()["apex target"]["position"], dtype=float)
+    quat = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+
+    s.record_start()
+
+    def pick_and_place(src, dest, place_z, name):
+        sx, sy = float(src[0]), float(src[1])
+        dx, dy = float(dest[0]), float(dest[1])
+
+        # Approach vertically, close around the cube, and lift clear of the table.
+        p["open_gripper"](ARM, steps=20)
+        p["move_ee"](ARM, [sx, sy, 0.94], quat, linear=4, tol=0.02)
+        p["move_ee"](ARM, [sx, sy, 0.785], quat, linear=5, tol=0.02)
+        p["close_gripper"](ARM, steps=30)
+        p["hold"](10)
+        p["move_ee"](ARM, [sx, sy, 0.95], quat, linear=5, tol=0.02)
+
+        # Carry at a fixed height so the cube clears all other scene objects.
+        p["move_ee"](ARM, [dx, dy, 0.95], quat, linear=5, tol=0.02)
+        p["move_ee"](ARM, [dx, dy, place_z], quat, linear=5, tol=0.02)
+        p["open_gripper"](ARM, steps=25)
+        p["hold"](35)
+        p["move_ee"](ARM, [dx, dy, 0.96], quat, linear=5, tol=0.02)
+        print(name, "released; objects:", flush=True)
+        for obj_name in ("base cube 1", "base cube 2", "apex cube"):
+            print(" ", obj_name, s.objects()[obj_name]["position"], flush=True)
+
+    # Put base cube 1 under the target, then base cube 2 adjacent to it.
+    pick_and_place([0.55857, 0.05810], target[:2], 0.79, "base1")
+    neighbor = target[:2] + np.array([0.058, 0.0])
+    pick_and_place([0.58972, 0.24196], neighbor, 0.79, "base2")
+
+    # The red apex cube sits directly on the base cube centered over the green dot.
+    pick_and_place([0.54988, 0.00011], target[:2], 0.84, "apex")
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    print("recorded", actions.shape, "status", s.status(), flush=True)
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"description": "fixed-scene stack_cubes placement"})
+    replay = s.replay(actions)
+    print("replay", replay, flush=True)
+    if not replay["success"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("recorded trajectory did not pass the replay success predicate")
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"description": "validated fixed-scene stack_cubes placement", "replay": replay})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
